Why You Should Invest :

Investing is a key strategy for building wealth and achieving financial security. Here are some of the main reasons people invest:

◉ Grow Wealth and Combat Inflation

  • Wealth Growth: Investments like stocks, real estate, and mutual funds have the potential to generate returns that outpace standard savings accounts, allowing your money to grow significantly over time.
  • Inflation Protection: Inflation gradually decreases the value of cash. Investments typically offer higher returns than traditional savings, helping to preserve and grow your purchasing power.

◉ Generate Passive Income

  • Income Streams: Investments in assets like dividend-paying stocks, real estate (through rental income), and bonds can create a regular income stream, supplementing or even replacing salary income.
  • Financial Freedom: With enough passive income, you can work less or retire early, freeing up time for other pursuits.

◉ Achieve Long-Term Financial Goals

  • Retirement: Many people invest to build a retirement fund, often through retirement accounts like a 401(k) or IRA, to ensure a comfortable post-career lifestyle.
  • Other Life Goals: Investments can help fund goals like buying a home, starting a business, or funding children's education, typically requiring a sizable amount over a long period.

◉ Take Advantage of Compounding

  • Exponential Growth: By reinvesting earnings, you allow your investment returns to start generating their own returns, creating a snowball effect. This compounding accelerates wealth growth, especially over longer time horizons.

◉ Diversify and Manage Risk

  • Spreading Risk: By investing across different asset types (like stocks, bonds, real estate, etc.), you reduce the risk of losing money if any single investment underperforms.
  • Building a Safety Net: Investments provide a financial cushion that can be accessed in emergencies or unexpected life events, contributing to financial resilience.

◉ Opportunity for High Returns

  • Outperforming Savings Accounts: Bank savings accounts offer limited returns, often below the inflation rate. Investments in higher-yield options (like stocks and real estate) give your money the potential for significant appreciation.
  • Beating Market Averages: With the right investment choices and strategies, there is an opportunity to earn returns that can far exceed traditional savings or fixed-income products.

◉ Personal and Financial Independence

  • Flexibility and Control: Investment success can open up choices—whether to pursue personal passions, travel, or even leave a legacy for future generations.

Why You Should Invest :

Investing is a key strategy for building wealth and achieving financial security. Here are some of the main reasons people invest:

◉ Grow Wealth and Combat Inflation

  • Wealth Growth: Investments like stocks, real estate, and mutual funds have the potential to generate returns that outpace standard savings accounts, allowing your money to grow significantly over time.
  • Inflation Protection: Inflation gradually decreases the value of cash. Investments typically offer higher returns than traditional savings, helping to preserve and grow your purchasing power.

◉ Generate Passive Income

  • Income Streams: Investments in assets like dividend-paying stocks, real estate (through rental income), and bonds can create a regular income stream, supplementing or even replacing salary income.
  • Financial Freedom: With enough passive income, you can work less or retire early, freeing up time for other pursuits.

◉ Achieve Long-Term Financial Goals

  • Retirement: Many people invest to build a retirement fund, often through retirement accounts like a 401(k) or IRA, to ensure a comfortable post-career lifestyle.
  • Other Life Goals: Investments can help fund goals like buying a home, starting a business, or funding children's education, typically requiring a sizable amount over a long period.

◉ Take Advantage of Compounding

  • Exponential Growth: By reinvesting earnings, you allow your investment returns to start generating their own returns, creating a snowball effect. This compounding accelerates wealth growth, especially over longer time horizons.

◉ Diversify and Manage Risk

  • Spreading Risk: By investing across different asset types (like stocks, bonds, real estate, etc.), you reduce the risk of losing money if any single investment underperforms.
  • Building a Safety Net: Investments provide a financial cushion that can be accessed in emergencies or unexpected life events, contributing to financial resilience.

◉ Opportunity for High Returns

  • Outperforming Savings Accounts: Bank savings accounts offer limited returns, often below the inflation rate. Investments in higher-yield options (like stocks and real estate) give your money the potential for significant appreciation.
  • Beating Market Averages: With the right investment choices and strategies, there is an opportunity to earn returns that can far exceed traditional savings or fixed-income products.

◉ Personal and Financial Independence

  • Flexibility and Control: Investment success can open up choices—whether to pursue personal passions, travel, or even leave a legacy for future generations.
  • Security: Knowing you have financial resources set aside provides a sense of security and the freedom to make life decisions without being solely reliant on employment income.

Type of Investment

MUTUAL FUND

We understand that not every investor wants high risk so we also guide our clients to invest in Bonds which is considered one of the safest investment option. Bond is a loan which is given to government of rated companies for regular interest payments and the promise to return your money at maturity. We guide t select the right bond investment option as per you risk appetite, income needs, finical goals, your age and future uncertainty.

Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs)

NCDs provide investment opportunities that combines stability with attractive return. Unlike shares NCDs do not give ownership but provide investors with fixed interest income at regular intervals. Main feature of NCDs are Fixed Return, Regular Payout, Tradable, Both Secured & Unsecured, Tenure Options ranging from 1-10 years. Always check rating of the NCDs, yield, and marketability.

Equity Shares

EQUITY = OWNERSHIP VALUE IN A COMPANY

Equity shares, also known as ordinary shares, represent ownership in a company. When you buy equity shares you become a part owner of the company and are entitled to a share of its profits in the form of dividend and assets, as well as voting rights on major decisions. Equity shares are very liquid and marketable and easily tradable at stock exchanges. Equity shares have ownership rights, voting power, dividend, loan term wealth creation, residual claim. At SKS INFI we assure to invest in best company having future prospect, and growth so investor can get best return on their investment.

Unlisted Shares

Unlisted shares are also equity shares but not traded on any stock exchange. Unlisted shares belong to private companies, starts ups and pre-IPO companies and usually bought and sold through private transaction of over-the counter (OTC) markets. Unlisted shares have high growth potential but not traded on stock exchanges so liquidity remains limited. We assist investors to understand both listed and unlisted stock exchange so they can make make choice for long term wealth creation.

STEPS TO START INVESTING

Define you Goals

Decide why you want to invest – wealth creation, retirement, child / children’s education, buying a house, foreign travel, retirement benefit. Investment strategy should always be divided in two parts one for short term ( 1-3 years ) and another long term investment ( 3+ years)

Assess Your Risk Appetite

Assessment of risk appetite is a important part. For senior citizens Fixed Deposits, Govt. Bonds are best and risk free while for a age of 25-45 years a combination of mutual fund, equity shares and unlisted equity shares is a best option. Age between 45-60 a combination of mutual funds, Bonds and FD is a best strategy.

Build an Emergency Fund & Health Insurance

Before start investing for long term always keep at least 6 months expenses in your saving accounts or keep in the form of flexi FD or liquid mutual fund. Always remember that this fund is for emergency so do not use until emergencies arise.

Choose the Right Investment.

Choosing of right investment is a very calculative work which requires your monthly expenses, age, monthly income, number of children, insurance cover for your family, age, inflation and many more but keep in mind investment should always be safe, reliable and growth potential.

Start Small & Diversify

Always start investing in small and from safe investment like FD, G-Sec and further allocating it to mutual fund, equity, unlisted shares. Always keeps your investment in “532” for long term like 50% in Equity / Unlisted shares/Mutual Fund/SIP, 30% in Bonds/NCDs and 20% in FDs/G-Sec/ Gold etc.

Track & Review Regularly

It is very much necessary to “Track and Review” your portfolio in every 6-12 months. Change the portfolio in time and rebalance it according to market condition. It is an important part of your investment strategy otherwise building long term net worth in future will not be easy.
